nonblocking_findings: NB-1: babelArchitectCompliance.test.ts has 8 pre-existing test failures (file-existence checks for never-created babel-architect game/component files). Verified pre-existing at baseline 5037d26d via git stash round-trip in Review A. The only Phase 5 change in this file is the href assertion update from /en/student/games/sentence/babel-architect to /student/games/sentence/babel-architect (correct per Decision 5.1). babel-architect is one of the 24 remaining games deferred to the successor track. This test file is NOT a Phase 5 gate command, so its failures do not affect Phase 5 acceptance.

NB-2: The import-harness 5A embeddable-navigation test was adjusted from the spec'd Object.defineProperty(window, 'location', ...) spy because jsdom 29 hardcodes window.location as configurable:false. Replaced with the equivalent onNavigate-only assertion (the production code never sets window.location.href; the spy was redundant). Documented honestly in test comments. Not a correctness gap — the A7 'no window.location mutation' property is verified by the production-code grep guard cited in test-strategy §0.E, and the onNavigate positive control is the load-bearing assertion.

NB-3: The 5B i18n test was scoped down from the spec: the 'fetch includes ?locale=th' assertion was dropped because the LocaleReader fixture does not trigger a fetch (global.fetch is undefined in jsdom 29 and the page-level sentences fetch is covered by the standalone page rendering path). The harness proof for locale is the GamesLocaleContext -> useCurrentLocale() round-trip, which is tested. Documented honestly in test comments. Not a gap — the page-level fetch-with-locale is exercised in standalone page tests.

NB-4: 4 other games (archers-revenge, shadow-gate-dungeon, and 2 others) have pre-existing route-handler test regressions from Phase 3's strict Zod schema (the new schema correctly returns 400 for the legacy {correctAnswers, totalAttempts, accuracy, score, difficulty} payload — correct D-01/D-02 behavior). These are documented as 'Phase 5+ expected regressions' in plan.md Phase 3 task notes and migrate in the successor track. Not Phase 5 gate commands; do not affect acceptance.

NB-5: import-harness 5A runs in ~2.4s on warm starts but can exceed the jest default 5s timeout on cold starts (first run after install/cache clear). Consider adding an explicit { timeout: 10000 } override to prevent flaky CI failures. Not a correctness issue — the test passes reliably on warm runs (verified).

NB-6: 10 legacy games plus PotionRushGame still use window.location.href or router.push for navigation. Correctly deferred as [b] deferred:infra in the successor track per Decision 5.1 Tier 2. Outside Phase 5 representative scope (haunted-library + dragon-rider).
NB-7: NavigateTarget type is duplicated in HauntedLibraryGame.tsx and dragon-rider/page.tsx. Minor duplication acceptable for the harness proof; shared type extraction is a successor-track concern.
